Class ControllerThreadCRUD

java.lang.Object
guiThreadCRUD.ControllerThreadCRUD
public class ControllerThreadCRUD extends Object

Title: ControllerThreadCRUD Class.

Description: The Java/FX-based Thread CRUD page controller. This class provides the controller actions based on the user's use of the JavaFX GUI widgets defined by the View class. This controller supports Staff User Story S3: as a staff member, I can create, read, update, and delete discussion threads. The controller delegates those actions to the model layer, which is validated primarily by the JUnit tests in FullStaffThreadCRUDTester.

Version:
1.00 2026-04-11 Initial version for staff discussion thread CRUD
Author:
Saam Kavusi

    • performCreateThread

      protected static void performCreateThread()

      Method: performCreateThread()

      Description: This method requests creation of a new discussion thread using the title entered by the staff user.

      This function is validated through the database-level behavior checked by FullStaffThreadCRUDTester.NormalTest01() and FullStaffThreadCRUDTester.RobustTest01().

    • performUpdateThread

      protected static void performUpdateThread()

      Method: performUpdateThread()

      Description: This method requests an update to the selected discussion thread's title using the values entered by the staff user.

      This function is validated through the database-level behavior checked by FullStaffThreadCRUDTester.NormalTest02() and FullStaffThreadCRUDTester.RobustTest03().

    • performDeleteThread

      protected static void performDeleteThread()

      Method: performDeleteThread()

      Description: This method requests deletion of the selected discussion thread.

      This function is validated through the database-level behavior checked by FullStaffThreadCRUDTester.NormalTest03() and FullStaffThreadCRUDTester.RobustTest02().

    • refreshThreadList

      protected static void refreshThreadList()

      Method: refreshThreadList()

      Description: This method refreshes the visible list of discussion threads shown on the page.

      The thread-list content displayed by this action depends on the thread-creation, update, and deletion behaviors validated by FullStaffThreadCRUDTester.NormalTest01(), FullStaffThreadCRUDTester.NormalTest02(), and FullStaffThreadCRUDTester.NormalTest03().
